description: AI lists as graphs (context/designs/modding/ai-list-graphs.md): the two simulant commands run through their graph twins. A Combat match on Complex with 4 simulants: the stage's background list 0x1000 runs mp_init_simulants (the whole wave completes), and the harness kills a simulant twice through the ordinary damage path (kill_simulant; in 90 s on Car Park and 150 s on Complex the simulants only shot the idle player, 2026-11-16, so none died on its own). Each dead simulant runs global list 0x0028, whose if_bot_respawning goes on while it waits (branch=0) and jumps to label 0x16 once it has respawned (branch=1).

input_sequence.comment: Pause until the local player of the Complex match is spawned and live.
The first live simulant dies; its dead list waits for its respawn.
A second death, after the first simulant has had 40 s to respawn.
45 s after the second death: both waits and respawns are in the log.

required_lines: SCENARIO\.GRAPH: AI simulant commands '[^']+' if_bot_respawning=1 mp_init_simulants=1 backend=graph\.ai\.simulant
SCENARIO\.GRAPH: AI action mp_init_simulants wave=complete source=
SCENARIO\.GRAPH: AI condition if_bot_respawning chr=[0-9]+ simulant=1 label=22 branch=0
SCENARIO\.GRAPH: AI condition if_bot_respawning chr=[0-9]+ simulant=1 label=22 branch=1
forbidden_patterns: missing executable AI simulant source nodes
